verses.gurmukhi: ਪਉੜੀ ੬ : ਪੂਰੇ ਗੁਰੂ ਬਾਝ ਰੋਣਾ ਹੀ ਰੋਣਾ
verses.translit_en: pauRee 6 : poore guroo baajh ronaa hee ronaa

en.bdb: Weeping and wailing without the perfect Guru

verses.gurmukhi: ਸਚੁ ਦਾਤਾਰੁ ਵਿਸਾਰ ਕੈ ਮੰਗਤਿਆਂ ਨੋ ਮੰਗਣ ਜਾਹੀ।
verses.translit_en: sach dhaataar visaar kai ma(n)gatiaa(n) no ma(n)gan jaahee|

en.bdb: Forgetting the true bestower, people spread their hands before the beggars.

verses.gurmukhi: ਢਾਢੀ ਵਾਰਾਂ ਗਾਂਵਦੇ ਵੈਰ ਵਿਰੋਧ ਜੋਧ ਸਾਲਾਹੀ।
verses.translit_en: ddaaddee vaaraa(n) gaa(n)vadhe vair virodh jodh saalaahee|

en.bdb: The bards sing of the brave works pertaining to the brave and eulogise the duels and enmities of the warriors.

verses.gurmukhi: ਨਾਈ ਗਾਵਨਿ ਸੱਦੜੇ ਕਰਿ ਕਰਤੂਤਿ ਮੁਏ ਬਦਰਾਹੀ।
verses.translit_en: naiee gaavan sa'dhaRe kar karatoot mue badharaahee|

en.bdb: The barbers also sing the praises of those who have died treading evil path and committing evil deeds.

verses.gurmukhi: ਪੜਦੇ ਭਟ ਕਵਿਤ ਕਰਿ ਕੂੜ ਕੁਸਤੁ ਮੁਖਹਿ ਅਲਾਹੀ।
verses.translit_en: paRadhe bhaT kavit kar kooR kusat mukheh alaahee|

en.bdb: The eulogisers recite poetry for false kings and go on telling lies.

verses.gurmukhi: ਹੋਇ ਅਸਿਰਿਤ ਪੁਰੋਹਿਤਾ ਪ੍ਰੀਤਿ ਪਰੀਤੈ ਵਿਰਤਿ ਮੰਗਾਹੀ।
verses.translit_en: hoi asirit purohitaa preet pareetai virat ma(n)gaahee|

en.bdb: The priests first seek shelter but afterwards lay their claim of bread and butter i.e. they entangle people in the fear of the net of ritualism.

verses.gurmukhi: ਛੁਰੀਆ ਮਾਰਨਿ ਪੰਖੀਏ ਹਟਿ ਹਟਿ ਮੰਗਦੇ ਭਿਖ ਭਵਾਹੀ।
verses.translit_en: chhureeaa maaran pa(n)khe'ee haT haT ma(n)gadhe bhikh bhavaahee|

en.bdb: The people belonging to the sects of persons wearing feathers on their heads punch their bodies with knives and go on begging from shop to shop.
But without the perfect Guru, they all wail and weep bitterly.
